mapper.select: select * from inventory where station_id = #{stationId} and water_type_id = #{waterTypeId}
mapper.insert: insert into inventory(water_type_id, station_id, quantity, update_time) values(#{waterTypeId}, #{stationId}, #{quantity}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select i.*, w.name as waterTypeName, w.spec as specification from inventory i left join water_type w on i.water_type_id = w.id
